consequence.statement: Users can now edit HTTP repository credentials through the Argo CD UI; the previously broken feature is restored with no negative operational impact.

original.statement: A bug preventing editing of HTTP repository credentials from the Argo CD UI is fixed.

decision.reason: [ev-74436eba649a] lists this only as a bug fix in the changelog: it restores the ability to edit HTTP repo credentials from the Argo CD UI. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. So if an operator does nothing, they just get the fixed UI, and 'none' (informational) fits. The evidence does not state the consequence outright, so confidence is low.
